title: Whole Broad-Cupped-Petals Long-Column Hibiscus
description: One newly authored whole static stylised hibiscus-like above-ground flowering shoot. A continuous curved stem with a finite basal cut and two broad pointed thick leaves supports a single large open cup of five genuinely thick curved broad petals. Their inner and outer faces flare from one green receptacle around a conspicuously long projecting central column, whose thicker distal end has an integral five-lobed outline. All stem, broad leaf and cupped petal stations newly drawn, not a daffodil with its corona removed or an orchid with extra side petals. The broad shared cup and long central column are the whole flower structure, not petal-count or colour variation. One plant model zero scenes. Opaque artistic exterior; no exact species, pollen/anther microanatomy, reproductive function, pollination, growth, roots, cultivation, medical or ecological performance claim.
